g.text: From a logged-in session to an overview of analyzed clips, then into one flagged moment with its score and threshold.
“As a site lead, I want a simple overview of analyzed clips and unusual movement windows, so I can decide what deserves review.”
Login page instead of the app;
Upload a video or record one
Tracks A, B, C … per clip
Newest 20 in the team’s shared History · summaries only
Start–end times from the scoring API
Trained threshold is fixed; a custom
Site lead decides what deserves review
Replay the moment from the local video, then follow up on site or move on.
This decision is made by the site lead and is not recorded in the app.
